```{r}
plot_rel_abund_by_group <- function(ps,
                                    group_var,
                                    taxrank = "Family",
                                    top_n = 10,
                                    other_label = "Other",
                                    palette = NULL,
                                    fun = c("mean","median")) {
  stopifnot(inherits(ps, "phyloseq"))
  fun <- match.arg(fun)

  smp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  if (!group_var %in% colnames(smp)) {
    stop(sprintf("'%s' non è presente in sample_data(ps).", group_var))
  }

  # 1) relative abundance + agglomerazione
  ps_rel <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) if (sum(x) == 0) x else x / sum(x))
  ps_ag  <- phyloseq::tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = taxrank, NArm = TRUE)

  # 2) long table
  df <- phyloseq::psmelt(ps_ag)
  df$Taxon <- as.character(df[[taxrank]])
  df[[group_var]] <- droplevels(as.factor(df[[group_var]]))

  # 3) top taxa
  top_taxa <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Taxon) |>
    dplyr::summarise(avg = mean(.data$Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::slice_max(avg, n = top_n) |>
    dplyr::pull(.data$Taxon)

  df$Taxon <- ifelse(df$Taxon %in% top_taxa, df$Taxon, other_label)
  df$Taxon <- forcats::fct_inorder(df$Taxon)

  # 4) composizione media o mediana per gruppo
  if (fun == "mean") {
    plot_df <- df |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_var]], .data$Taxon) |>
      dplyr::summarise(Abundance = mean(.data$Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    plot_df <- df |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_var]], .data$Taxon) |>
      dplyr::summarise(Abundance = stats::median(.data$Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  }

  plot_df <- plot_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_var]]) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # 5) palette colori
  if (is.null(palette)) {
    palette <- scales::hue_pal()(length(levels(plot_df$Taxon)))
  }
  names(palette) <- levels(plot_df$Taxon)

  # 6) plot con contorni neri
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = Abundance, fill = Taxon)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.9, color = "black", size = 0.2) +   # ⬅️ bordo nero sottile
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance",
      title = NULL,
      fill = taxrank
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_linedraw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}
```

Phylum
```{r echo=TRUE}
#Associazioni delle 7 Variabili in esame con Metagenomica by DEseq2
plotList = list()
ps_filt = merge_phyloseq(ps_filt, sample_data(sampleDt))
desRes = list()
plot_listDEseq2 <- list()
CatVars = c("HyperglicemiaMetS", "TrygliceridesMetS", "HypertensionMets", "HDL_MetS")
#ps.filt.DESeq = tax_glom(ps.filt.DESeq, "Genus")
for (col in CatVars) {


  sampleDt.deseq =  as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_filt))
  #row.names(sampleDt.deseq) = row.names(sampleDt.cp)
  sampleDt.deseq = sampleDt.deseq[(sampleDt.deseq[,col]) != "",]
  if (! col %in% c("age", "HOMA", "QUICKI")) {
  sampleDt.deseq[[col]] = as.factor(sampleDt.deseq[[col]])
  }
  sampleDt.deseq[["sex"]] = as.factor(sampleDt.deseq[["sex"]])
  sampleDt.deseq[["Batch"]] = as.factor(sampleDt.deseq[["Batch"]])
  #sampleDt.deseq[["gruppo"]] = as.factor(sampleDt.deseq[["gruppo"]])
  ps.filt.DESeq = merge_phyloseq(otu_table(ps_filt), tax_table(ps_filt), sample_data(sampleDt.deseq))
  sample_data(ps.filt.DESeq) = sample_data(sampleDt.deseq)
  
  #ps.filt.DESeq = tax_glom(ps.filt.DESeq, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = T)
  ps.filt.DESeq.cp = ps.filt.DESeq
  p = plot_rel_abund_by_group(ps.filt.DESeq.cp, col,top_n = 15, taxrank = "Phylum" )
  p <- p +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    ncol = 3,                # due colonne
    title.position = "top"   # <-- sposta "Genus" sopra la legenda
  ))

  plotList[[col]] = p 
  }



```

```{r}
## Requisiti
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

## Parametri
alpha <- 0.054
CatVars <- c("HyperglicemiaMetS", "TrygliceridesMetS", "HypertensionMets", "HDL_MetS", "MetS")

theme_set(theme_bw())

## 1) Ricava la lista globale dei Phylum significativi in TUTTI i confronti
all_sig_phyla <- unique(unlist(lapply(CatVars, function(col){
  df <- as.data.frame(desRes[[col]])
  if(!"padj" %in% names(df)) return(NA_character_)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj <= alpha, , drop = FALSE]
  as.character(df$Phylum)
})))
all_sig_phyla <- setdiff(all_sig_phyla, c(NA, "", "NA"))

## 2) Crea una palette coerente per tutti i Phylum
##    - se i phyla > 12 usa Set3 estesa con colorRampPalette
if(length(all_sig_phyla) <= 12){
  pal <- brewer.pal(max(3, length(all_sig_phyla)), "Set2")
  pal <- pal[seq_along(all_sig_phyla)]
} else {
  pal <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(length(all_sig_phyla))
}
phyla_colors <- setNames(pal, all_sig_phyla)

## 3) Loop sui confronti e crea i plot con la stessa mappa colori
plot_listDEseq2 <- list()

for(col in CatVars){
  sigtab <- as.data.frame(desRes[[col]])
  if(nrow(sigtab) == 0) next
  
  ## Filtra significativi
  sigtab <- sigtab[!is.na(sigtab$padj) & sigtab$padj <= alpha, , drop = FALSE]
  if(nrow(sigtab) == 0) next
  
  ## Phylum/Genus come character
  sigtab$Phylum <- as.character(sigtab$Phylum)
  sigtab$Genus  <- as.character(sigtab$Genus)
  
  ## Ordine Phylum per max log2FC
  x <- tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Phylum, function(v) max(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  x <- sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)
  sigtab$Phylum <- factor(sigtab$Phylum, levels = names(x))
  
  ## Ordine Genus per max log2FC
  xg <- tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Genus, function(v) max(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  xg <- sort(xg, decreasing = TRUE)
  sigtab$Genus <- factor(sigtab$Genus, levels = names(xg))
  
  ## Rimuovi Genera NA letterali
  sigtab <- sigtab[!is.na(sigtab$Genus) & sigtab$Genus != "NA", , drop = FALSE]
  if(nrow(sigtab) == 0) next
  
  ## Plot con palette Phylum coerente (drop=FALSE per mostrare solo presenti ma mantenere mappa)
  p <- ggplot(sigtab, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = Genus, color = Phylum)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = phyla_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 8.5)) +
    ggtitle(col)
  
  plot_listDEseq2[[col]] <- p
  
  ## Salva
 
}

## Esempio: stampa i tre plot che ti interessano con colori coerenti
## print(plot_listDEseq2[["HyperglicemiaMetS"]])
## print(plot_listDEseq2[["HypertensionMets"]])

 print(plot_listDEseq2[["HDL_MetS"]])

```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

# 1) Define a global set of Phyla across the selected traits
sel <- c("HyperglicemiaMetS","TrygliceridesMetS","HypertensionMets","HDL_MetS")

all_phyla <- unique(unlist(lapply(sel, function(col){
  df <- as.data.frame(desRes[[col]])
  as.character(df$Phylum)
})))
all_phyla <- setdiff(all_phyla, c(NA,"","NA"))

# 2) Build one consistent color palette (named vector) for ALL plots
if (length(all_phyla) <= 12) {
  pal <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(all_phyla)), "Set2")[seq_along(all_phyla)]
} else {
  pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12,"Set3"))(length(all_phyla))
}
phyla_colors <- setNames(pal, all_phyla)

# 3) Rebuild plots with the SAME factor levels & SAME scale_color_manual
plots_uniform <- lapply(sel, function(col){
  sigtab <- as.data.frame(desRes[[col]])
  sigtab <- sigtab[!is.na(sigtab$padj) & sigtab$padj <= 0.054, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sigtab) == 0) return(NULL)

  sigtab$Genus  <- as.character(sigtab$Genus)
  sigtab$Phylum <- factor(as.character(sigtab$Phylum), levels = all_phyla)  # <- identical levels

  # Order Genus (optional)
  ordG <- tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Genus, function(v) max(v, na.rm=TRUE))
  ordG <- sort(ordG, decreasing = TRUE)
  sigtab$Genus <- factor(sigtab$Genus, levels = names(ordG))

  ggplot(sigtab, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = Genus, color = Phylum)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = phyla_colors,
      breaks = names(phyla_colors),  # same order in legend
      drop = FALSE                   # keep absent phyla in legend
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.spacing = unit(4,"pt"),
      plot.margin   = margin(2,6,2,6,"pt"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ggtitle(col)
})

# Remove NULLs (if a trait had no significant ASVs)
plots_uniform <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots_uniform)


# Combina i plot SENZA leggenda globale
combined_2x2 <- wrap_plots(plots_uniform, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")   # <<--- qui funziona

print(combined_2x2)

ggsave(
  "figure1_doublecolumn.png",
  plot = combined_2x2,
  width = 28,   # cm
  height = 32,    # cm (adatta in base ai tuoi pannelli)
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600
)
```

```{r}
# Seleziona solo MetS
col <- "MetS"

# Estrai e filtra i dati significativi
sigtab <- as.data.frame(desRes[[col]])
sigtab <- sigtab[!is.na(sigtab$padj) & sigtab$padj <= 0.054, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(sigtab) > 0) {
  # Imposta i livelli del Phylum in modo coerente con gli altri plot
  sigtab$Phylum <- factor(as.character(sigtab$Phylum), levels = all_phyla)

  # Ordina i Genera in base al log2FC
  ordG <- tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Genus, function(v) max(v, na.rm = TRUE))
  ordG <- sort(ordG, decreasing = TRUE)
  sigtab$Genus <- factor(as.character(sigtab$Genus), levels = names(ordG))

  # Costruisci il plot
  p_MetS <- ggplot(sigtab, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = Genus, color = Phylum)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = phyla_colors,
      breaks = names(phyla_colors),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
   # coord_flip() + 
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.spacing = unit(4, "pt"),
      plot.margin   = margin(2, 6, 2, 6, "pt"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 8),
      
       axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    ggtitle("MetS")

  print(p_MetS)

} else {
  message("No significant ASVs for MetS at FDR ≤ 0.054.")
}
```
